name: Papu Ka Dhaba
why_it_matters: The default Shimla–Kinnaur–Spiti road-trip lunch stop on NH-5 at Tapri (~133km from Narkanda). Travel guides for the Hindustan-Tibet Road specifically flag it by name — paratha is the morning order, dal-rajma the afternoon. No menu, no frills, the kitchen runs on volume.
insider_tip: Stop here, not Powari, if you've started from Shimla — Tapri is the cleaner of the two NH-5 dhaba clusters and parking is easier. Cash only; the queue moves fast because everyone orders the same three things.
signature_address: Papu Dhaba, NH-5, Tapri, Nichar Tehsil, Kinnaur

name: Lungta Cafe
why_it_matters: TripAdvisor's #1-of-1 standalone restaurant in Pooh, on NH-5 between Kalpa and Nako. 3.7/5 across 3 reviews — small sample, but the only dedicated cafe in this 58km road-stretch from Powari. Rooftop-style seating with a view down to the Sutlej confluence.
insider_tip: Reviews are mixed — kitchen quality depends on the day. Order what's freshly cooked (ask the staff what came in this morning) and skip pre-made items. Open 12am–11:59pm officially but call ahead if arriving late evening.

name: Mountain's Pizza Club
why_it_matters: Reckong Peo's surprise pizza joint at Negi Complex on the Main Chowk Pangi Road — 4.7/5 across 626 JustDial reviews, the highest-rated standalone restaurant in the Kinnaur district HQ town. Vegan and kid-menu options listed, which is rare at 2,290m.
insider_tip: Open 10am — useful for the road-out-of-Kinnaur lunch slot before climbing to Kalpa. Same brand as the Shimla outlet; it's a small franchise rather than a one-off.
signature_address: Negi Complex, Khwangi, Main Chowk Pangi Road, Reckong Peo, Kinnaur 172107

name: Shivling View Restaurant & Bar
signature_dish: tandoori platter with Shivling rock view
why_it_matters: Bar-restaurant near the PWD Rest House in Reckong Peo, named for the Shivling rock visible across at Kalpa. One of the few mid-range restaurants in the district HQ that holds a liquor licence — used by government and PWD groups passing through.
insider_tip: Drinks before food — the kitchen turns slow when the bar is busy. View is from the road-side of the building, not a deck; ask for a window table.
signature_address: Near PWD Rest House, Reckong Peo, Kinnaur 172107
